ENCOUNTER:
On June 25, 2024, at approximately 2315 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stopped a van with three occupants on I-94 near Battle Creek, Michigan, at the request of the Michigan State Police. All three stated that they are citizens of Mexico without documents.
INTERVIEWS:
[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stated that he crossed near Laredo, Texas, on 03/03/2021.
[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stated that he crossed near Laredo, Texas, on 07/19/2018.
The third occupant did not answer questions.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
All three were transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Station.
